name: 2PM Gen3
measure_description: Measured on 2026-10-02 with Shelly Plug S 1D3A67; 60-second means for relay states 00, 10, 01 and 11. WLAN + ECO uses a parallel dummy load: 9.1 W measured separately as a 60-second mean and subtracted from all four totals. Latest repeat used for WLAN + AP + ECO. Relay increment = (P11 - P00) / 2.
config_flow_sub_profile_remarks: Select the measured WLAN / BT / ECO / AP combination matching your device settings. AP means access point, BT means Bluetooth. This profile covers self-consumption in two-relay switch mode. Select both output switch entities. Settings are not detected automatically; change the selected subprofile after changing device settings.
